title: ScaleFold: Reducing AlphaFold Initial Training Time to 10 Hours
problem: AlphaFold2 training is prohibitively time-consuming and suffers from poor scaling efficiency to multiple compute resources. Inefficient communications and overhead-dominated computations prevent effective distributed training.
motivation: Accelerating AlphaFold training enables faster model iteration and broader adoption of this protein structure prediction breakthrough.
method: ScaleFold applies systematic optimizations targeting identified bottlenecks in communication patterns and computational overhead during distributed AlphaFold training. The approach scales across 2080 NVIDIA H100 GPUs while maintaining high resource utilization through communication optimization and reduced overhead-dominated operations.
key_novelty: Systematic identification and targeted optimization of communication inefficiencies and computational overhead to enable efficient scaling of AlphaFold training to thousands of GPUs.
contributions: Comprehensive analysis identifying inefficient communications and overhead-dominated computations as key AlphaFold scaling bottlenecks
ScaleFold systematic training method with optimizations for identified factors
Successful scaling to 2080 H100 GPUs with high resource utilization
Reduced pretraining from 7 days to 10 hours with 6x speedup on MLPerf HPC v3.0

metrics.speedup: 6x on MLPerf HPC v3.0 benchmark; 7 days reduced to 10 hours for pretraining

primary_theme: distributed training optimization for GPU scaling
